title: Kitchen
story: Everything you need for a cozy bake and a hot breakfast.

cards.name: Frying Pan
cards.subject: A round black frying pan seen at a slight angle, with a short straight handle attached to the rim and a fried egg with a white and a yellow yolk in the middle.
cards.hero_colors: charcoal grey, white and yellow egg, red handle

cards.name: Kettle
cards.subject: A symmetrical glossy stovetop kettle with a rounded body, a domed lid with a round knob, a curved spout on one side and an arched handle over the top attached on the other side.
cards.hero_colors: glossy red, silver lid knob, black handle

cards.name: Chopping Board
cards.subject: A rectangular wooden cutting board with a round hole in one end, seen from above, holding sliced tomato, sliced cucumber rounds and carrot coins in neat piles.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, red tomato, green cucumber, orange carrot

cards.name: Whisk
cards.subject: A balloon whisk with a row of looped steel wires joined at a round handle, standing upright and symmetrical, wires on top.

cards.name: Sink Tap
cards.subject: A chrome kitchen mixer tap with a tall curved spout and one lever handle, bolted to the back edge of a steel sink, with a few water drops falling from the spout, in front of a tiled wall.
cards.hero_colors: chrome silver, small blue lever tip
cards.surface_or_setting: back edge of a steel kitchen sink against a white tiled wall

cards.name: Toaster
cards.subject: A rounded rectangular two-slot toaster with a side lever and a round dial, with two golden toast slices popping up from the slots.
cards.hero_colors: shiny silver, golden toast, red dial

cards.name: Oven Mitts
cards.subject: A pair of thick quilted oven mitts, each with a thumb and a round cuff, side by side, with a small house pictogram stitched on the front of one mitt.
cards.hero_colors: orange, cream house patch, red cuff trim

cards.name: Rolling Pin
cards.subject: A wooden rolling pin with two round handles at the ends, lying on a flat round circle of white dough dusted with flour.
cards.hero_colors: light wood brown, cream dough, red handle ends

cards.name: Soup Pot
cards.subject: A round teal cooking pot with a lid and two side handles bolted to the body, standing on a gas stove burner over a bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling upward, and warm orange light cast on the pot, with steam rising from the lid.
cards.surface_or_setting: black gas stove top with a burner, in front of a yellow tiled wall

cards.name: Cookie Jar
cards.subject: A round ceramic cookie jar with a domed lid and a round knob, with a small flat one-color cow-face pictogram printed on the front, and cookies peeking over the rim under the lid.
cards.hero_colors: cream white, brown cow pictogram, red lid
